title: A benchmark dataset for defect detection and classification in electroluminescence images of PV modules using semantic segmentation
mechanism: Weighted cross-entropy with engineered class weights (crack 100, gridline 10, inactive 10, ribbons 3, DOE-validated) to lift recall of rare thin defects.
adaptation: Leave crack to the house Dice; apply capped weights (e.g. inverse-sqrt frequency, max 10) only to weak classes gridline, splice, edge_dark, material to lift mIoU_rob without dilating cracks.
min_experiment: Arm house + weak-class CE weights vs house, 5 seeds; mIoU_rob, gridline recall, splice IoU; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 or crack IoU drops > 0.01.
evidence: R: 593 cells, 50 test, 24 classes; DeepLabv3+ custom weights best: crack median IoU 0.25, recall 0.86, gridline recall 0.85, defect mIoU 0.28; equal weights defects 0.04 to 0.24; low precision from dilated predictions.
prior_overlap: Dice on 12 classes (worse) and on 3 (n.d.) tested; class-weighted CE on weak classes not listed. Open.
